scripts.prepare:dev: npm run structure:prepare && npm run tokens:build && npm run db:generate
scripts.build: npm run structure:prepare && npm run tokens:check && npm run architecture:check && npm run unused:check && npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @oneops/api && npm run build -w @oneops/web
scripts.lint: eslint apps/web/src apps/api/src packages/database/*.ts scripts tests --ignore-pattern "**/generated/**"
scripts.typecheck: npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.format: prettier --write apps/web/src apps/api/src packages/database/index.ts apps/api/test apps/web/*.ts apps/web/*.json apps/web/*.mjs apps/api/*.json packages/database/*.json packages/database/*.ts scripts tests *.ts *.mjs *.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps/web/src apps/api/src packages/database/index.ts apps/api/test apps/web/*.ts apps/web/*.json apps/web/*.mjs apps/api/*.json packages/database/*.json packages/database/*.ts scripts tests *.ts *.mjs *.json
scripts.db:generate: npm run prisma:generate -w @oneops/database && npm run db:build
scripts.test:api: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @oneops/api && node --test tests/api.integration.test.mjs
